cbd_concourse.name: 中央商务区站 · 站厅（B1）
cbd_concourse._doc: grand CBD concourse: polished stone, steel cladding, LED ad walls, bright warm-white light. Paid area in the middle (fences + 6 gate aisles on its south side, escalator + stairs down to the platform). Four exits A-D (escalator + stairs up) in the corners with yellow hanging signs. Security (X-ray + arch) west of the gates for the trip home.

cbd_platform.name: 中央商务区站 · 站台（B2，岛式）
cbd_platform._doc: island platform y 3.1..8.9 between two rows of platform screen doors. North track (y 9.15..11.95) = trains toward 科技园 (eastbound), south track = toward 槐北新村 (westbound). Car doors line up with the PSD door bays at x 2,6,10,14,18 (+2 m). Stairs up to the concourse in the middle. Trains, PSD states, countdown boards and boarding are run by js/metro.js from rules.metro.

cbd_street.name: 中央商务区站 · 地面出口
cbd_street._doc: CBD street stub: modern exit canopy (exit letter + destination drawn on the band) + sign post. South edge = exit to the CBD module (id 'cbd'); stairs = back down to the concourse (to the exit you came up).

jhl_concourse.name: 井槐里站 · 站厅（B1）
jhl_concourse._doc: older peripheral concourse: terrazzo, cool tile walls, fluorescent light. West: stairs up to the street, security (queue lane -> X-ray + walk-through arch, exit lane beside it guarded). Middle: 3 ticket machines (east wall), service counter (top up). Fare gate line y=6.6 (5 aisles, every aisle takes QR / token / card). Paid area north with the stairs down to the island platform.

jhl_street.name: 井槐里站 · 地面入口（井槐里路）
jhl_street._doc: street level: sidewalk slice with the metro entrance (canopy, lit name band, stairs down) + station sign post. South edge = back to the street (core). Built by tools/build_metro.py.

rules._doc: 地铁 metro (js/metro.js). Times in game minutes of the day, money in yuan. Fare by distance (km between stations), deducted on arrival (= tapping out). Built scenes: station.area (multi-area scenes in metro45.js); other stations are on the line but have no scene yet.

fare._doc: km travelled -> yuan (first band whose limit >= km)

headway_min._doc: minutes between trains per direction; peak = weekday peak windows, late = after late_after

rules._clock_doc: inside stations the clock runs at clock_scale game minutes per real second (6 game s per s; the street runs 1 min/s), so walking a station costs ~8-12 game minutes and a 1.2 min dwell is ~12 s to board

crowd._doc: waiting / walking NPCs per area = round(base * by_hour[h] * (weekend ? weekend_mul : 1)), capped at max

security._doc: 安检: bag through the X-ray + walk-through arch; skipping it is refused by staff
